verdict.rationale: Abacum's own pages state it builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow from live ERP actuals, with numbers kept "traceable" (abacum-docs-9). It also claims "real-time consolidation of the three statements with drill-down to source data" (abacum-docs-18), supported by connected ERPs and normalized charts of accounts (abacum-docs-5, abacum-docs-3). Missing for 10: in-depth documentation showing drill-down from any figure down to individual source transactions or records, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing claims.
